collection.title: Nissan Figaro 1991 to 1991 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Nissan Figaro Hatchback 1991 model requires a 18" wiper blade on both the drivers side the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
